text.description_html:
Acorn APCBP, Smooth Iron Square Cabinet Pull

Acorn's Square Tip Cabinet Door Pull is great for light interior doors, cabinet doors, and drawers. It can easily be mounted vertically or horizontally and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. The Square tip cabinet drawer pull has a smooth iron finish.

Smooth Iron surface hardware is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged.

Features and Specifications of the Acorn APCBP Square Tip Collection Cabinet Door Pull:

  • Length (center to center): 4-1/16"
  • Overall Length: 4-13/16"
  • Mount Width: 3/4"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Package includes 1 cabinet pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.

    • Sold Individually
